verdict.rationale: Expensify documents in-app travel booking for flights, hotels, cars and rail, and pitches it as ending the 'pile of receipts' after a trip. It also auto-matches scanned receipts to card transactions, imports digital receipts, and auto-submits reports. None of the evidence explicitly shows these pieces being grouped automatically into a single trip- or itinerary-linked report. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that bookings, card charges and receipts auto-group into one itinerary-linked report; independent or hands-on corroboration of trip-level consolidation.
